paper_title: Bounds on heavy axions with an X-ray free electron laser
notes: Light-shining-through-wall style axion search at EuXFEL using Primakoff conversion in Ge crystals. Bounds from Table I at 5 discrete detuning angles. The mass for the first row (Bragg, dtheta=0) is given as <=44 eV (plasma frequency); used 44 eV. Other masses read from Table I. Bounds are 90% CL upper limits on g_agamma. Each off-Bragg point is sensitive only to a narrow mass range (~1e-3 eV) centered on quoted mass. | selector: table (sole candidate)
